text: 🚨🎙️| Luis Suárez: "Leaving Barça? It HURTS to leave in 2020, but with time, I realised it may have been the best decision for everyone.” #fcblive

🚨🎙️| Juliano Belletti: “Is Hafiz Gariba is ready to step up to the first team? My job is to prepare Hafiz. He’s a very dynamic player, so his workload needs to be carefully managed. Our style of play demands a lot from him. He’s in good form, and the challenge is to maintain that level. Is he ready? All my players are ready, and I make sure they’re at their peak for the first team.” #fcblive

🚨🎙️| Juliano Belletti on Mirza Catovic: “He has settled in quickly and already adapted to our system. He can play as a defensive midfielder and, at times, as a central midfielder. He's strong, talented and highly motivated to make the most of his opportunities. He arrived with great humility, eager to adapt to what we expect from him, and he's making very good progress. As a coach, I'm looking to get the best out of him.” #fcblive

🚨🎙️| Juliano Belletti, on whether coaching Barcelona’s first team is his biggest ambition: “My main goal is to make sure my players are well prepared. I believe in taking things one step at a time. I did the same as a player, and I think it helped me. If I focus too much on the destination, I might lose sight of the journey. I want to do things the other way around, focusing on the process so that I’m better prepared when the time comes.” #fcblive

🚨🎖| 𝐉𝐔𝐒𝐓 𝐈𝐍: Alejandro Balde is considering LEAVING Barcelona, and Hansi Flick is waiting for his departure so the club can sign a new centre-back. [@HelenaCondis] #fcblive

🚨| 𝐉𝐔𝐒𝐓 𝐈𝐍: Barcelona are waiting to assess their FFP margin before strengthening their defense this winter. ​With recent renewals leaving no room to register new players, Alejandro Balde’s departure could be KEY. [@FCBRAC1] #fcblive

🚨 𝐁𝐑𝐄𝐀𝐊𝐈𝐍𝐆: Deco and Bojan imply Alejandro Balde’s WON'T LEAVE in winter —

🔹 Bojan: “Balde is a fantastic person who is going through a difficult period. Every player wants to play, especially someone who has grown up at this club. He remains important and is ready whenever the coach needs him.”

🔹 Deco on a potential sale: “No. Balde has already proven his quality by winning La Liga with Xavi. Football goes through different phases, and that doesn't mean he can't be back in the team tomorrow. He's young and can change his situation. He has never told us that he's unhappy.” #fcblive 👀

🚨🎙️| Deco: "How satisfied am I with the current squad? I'd say a 10. We have practically EVERYTHING we wanted. This has been the first year we've been able to plan in advance. In previous years, due to FFP, we couldn't." #fcblive
🚨🚨🎙️| Deco: "Will we go for Nico Schlotterbeck? It's better NOT to talk about him, otherwise his price will go up.” #fcblive 👀

🚨 Which signing did you regret NOT making? 

Deco: "Luis Díaz." #fcblive 🇨🇴

🚨🎙️| Deco: "Liverpool executing Araújo'a buy option? It's a matter for next summer. I'm happy with him. He's a LEADER, we have a good relationship, and we respect his decision. The main thing is seeing him happy, if he decides to stay at Liverpool and everything continues this way, we're fine and we'll be happy because it worked out for him. A little bit of money wouldn't hurt either." #fcblive 👀

🚨🎙️| Deco: “Signing a CB in January? Everything is possible. It's true that injuries have COMPLICATED things, and of course we have to analyze, sit down with the manager, and decide. To go in January, we have to know very well what we're looking for.” #fcblive

🚨🎙️| Bojan Krkic: “Signing a striker? Hansi Flick and his coaching staff felt that Raphinha had more freedom on the wing, but also had the ability to play as a 9. He’s proving to all of us that he can be a genuine No. 9, even against low blocks, which was one of the doubts. He’s performing at a very high level, so naturally, we're NOT thinking about signing a traditional striker for now.” #fcblive

🚨🎙️| Deco on Frenkie de Jong: “Was there tension between club and Frenkie about his injury? NO, there was no misunderstanding. He was having problems, which is understandable, and he decided against surgery. Everything has gone well. The decision was made in consultation with the medical department. The club doesn't impose its opinion on anyone; this is about the player's health.” #fcblive

🚨🎙️| Deco: “International football is always a difficult subject. Every year, new tournaments keep appearing. At least with the Nations League, teams remain in Europe. But someone needs to explain to me why Brazil have to play friendlies in Singapore and Japan mid season!” #fcblive 🇧🇷

🚨🎙️| Yves Bissouma (Ajax): “I really LIKE Frenkie de Jong as a player. I faced him only once, in a pre-season friendly between Tottenham and Barcelona around three years ago, and we immediately clicked after the game. I LOVE watching him play. He’s an excellent, intelligent player who makes everything look effortless. I think we see football in the same way. Of course, we’re not exactly the same player. He has qualities I don’t, and vice versa, but our understanding of football is very similar.” #fcblive ⭐
